intended_application: Proposed self-service AI content subscription with human editorial review, replacing some per-article delivery; not launched.
organization: Hypothetical commodity marketing-copy agency; assume 70% of revenue comes from routine per-article copy sold through account managers.
business_need: Respond to possible client self-production while creating recurring revenue.
users_stakeholders: Clients, writers, editors, account managers, owners.
adoption_posture: Aggressive experimentation; no evidence of client migration yet.
capabilities_constraints: Editing expertise and client relationships; no validated subscription willingness-to-pay, margin, churn or usage-cost data.
risk_consequence_context: Cannibalization, unreliable copy and loss of differentiation; economic viability uncertain.
management_question: Would the proposed service materially disrupt the current value-capture model?
time_horizon: Six-month offer experiment; twelve-month business-model outlook.
